crontab
=======

.. tip:: Ingestion into Splunk.

   **``linux:crontab``**

   * name_rex: ``\.jsonl$``
   * path_suffix: ``crontab``
   * sourcetype: ``linux:crontab``
   * host_rex: ``([\w\.-]+?)--``
   * artifact: ``crontab``

Description
-----------

System and user crontabs
